Downscale pressure with elevation effects

Source: R/spatialdownscale.R
presdownscale.Rd

Downscales an array of pressure data applying elevation effects

Usage

presdownscale(pk, dtmf, dtmc, sealevel = TRUE)

Arguments

pk

a SpatRast or array of atmospheric pressures (kPa). If an array dtmc must be provided.

dtmf

a fine-resolution SpatRast of elevations. Temperatures down-scaled to resolution of dtmf.

dtmc

optional SpatRast of elevations matching resolution of pk. If not supplied, pk must be a SpatRast and dtmc is derived by resampling dtmf to resolution of pk and extents must match.

sealevel

optional logical indicating whether pk is pressure at sea-level

Value

a multi-layer SpatRast of elevation-corrected pressures (kPa) matching the resolution of dtmf.

Examples

climdata<- read_climdata(mesoclim::ukcpinput)
pk <- presdownscale(climdata$pres, terra::rast(system.file('extdata/dtms/dtmf.tif',package='mesoclim')), climdata$dtm)
terra::panel(c(pk[[1]],pk[[5]],pk[[10]],pk[[20]]),main=paste0("Atmospheric pressure ",c(1,5,10,15),"/05/2018"))
